jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, eDiscovery Staffing
jobs.description:
**What is special about Lighthouse?**

Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together.

**What’s unique about this role?**

The position will work closely with the Lighthouse Client Services team, Account Management, Client Success, Spectra team, other Lighthouse teams such as Information Governance, Digital Forensics, Review Management, etc., client, and client’s vendors to achieve these objectives.

**What will this person do?**

* Contributing to the delivery of solutions to meet the client’s needs
* Managing the client and leading a dedicated Senior PM team while ensuring the delivery of the solution to meet the client’s needs.
* Managing litigations and investigations and providing consultative guidance as needed
* Executing work for the client in Spectra and Relativity to facilitate cases and investigations
* Helping to design methods, processes, metrics, and quality steps for collection, legal hold, discovery, and doc review
* Assisting to define requirements, select technology and services, and work with customers to implement technical discovery solutions
* Ensuring the clients are aware of and informed about the breadth of Lighthouse’s products and services
* Assisting with recruiting, interviewing, training, and mentoring client team members
* Serving as a key go-to resource for the client’s in-house legal teams for day-to-day task execution across the myriad of supported departments such as Legal, IT, Finance, etc.

**Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would also be great if you have the following:**

* Bachelor’s degree (Masters or JD a plus)
* 5+ years of successful experience in a law department, law firm and/or a legal consulting firm or eDiscovery provider
* High energy, collaborative team-player, and self-starter
* Experience with providing substantive legal advice concerning electronic discovery issues, including all aspects of the Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM), to the eDiscovery team, case teams and clients
* Experience with developing defensible strategies for eDiscovery collections, processing, culling, searching, and productions
* Experience with interfacing with in-house and/or outside counsel regarding eDiscovery issues and disputes
* Experience with advising clients regarding records management and data governance issues that relate to or impact the discovery of electronically stored information (ESI) in disputes proceedings
* Experience with working effectively with the eDiscovery team to provide the full range of eDiscovery services to disputes teams and clients and to be a thought leader on eDiscovery and data governance issues
* Experience with identifying opportunities for improvements, recommending a viable solution to the client, and implementing the project
* Strong client empathy and ability to build relationships with client
* Outstanding organizational skills and the ability to multitask

**Work Environment and Physical Demands**

* Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table.
* Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting.
* Duties may require being on call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).

Lighthouse celebrates and thrives on diversity and is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire, train, and promote regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We welcome any talents and contributions you can bring to the team and are deeply committed to growing an environment where everyone can feel safe, is respected, and can show up as themselves. Come as you are!

As required by applicable pay transparency laws, Lighthouse complies with compensation disclosure requirements for roles that may be hired in locations under these requirements. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include a wide array of factors, including: your specific skills and experience, geographic location, or other relevant factors. The salary range for this position may be tailored to be lower or higher in different talent markets.

This role will be eligible to participate in an annual bonus or incentive program.

Lighthouse offers a quality comprehensive benefits package including, medical, dental, vision, and a 401k with company match. Company paid benefits also include Life & AD&D, short and long-term disability, telemedicine, and other wellness plans. We offer a generous Flexible PTO program and paid volunteer days. Employees may also participate in voluntary insurance plans including accident, hospitalization, and critical illness plans as well as pet insurance.

As a trailblazer and catalyst for change, Lighthouse rises to each opportunity to help our clients and our people do what they do best—shine.

jobs.title: Software Program Manager
jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Working at Abbott**

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

At Abbott, we're committed to helping people with heart failure live longer, healthier lives through innovative medical technologies and digital solutions. Our products support clinicians in making informed treatment decisions and help improve outcomes for patients facing advanced cardiovascular disease.

We are seeking a Program Manager, Digital Solutions to lead software-focused product development initiatives supporting connected medical devices, digital health technologies, and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) solutions. This role partners closely with Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Engineering, Product Management, and Cybersecurity teams to deliver innovative, compliant, and high-quality products that improve patient care.

The successful candidate will be a strong program leader with experience driving software development projects, managing cross-functional teams, and enabling predictable execution within a regulated environment.

**What You'll Work On**

* Lead software and digital product development programs from planning through product release.
* Drive execution across Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Engineering, Product Management, and Cybersecurity teams.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, resource forecasts, and risk management strategies.
* Support implementation of effective software development processes and best practices.
* Coordinate software development activities including requirements management, implementation, verification, validation, and release planning.
* Ensure alignment between software, hardware, systems, and business deliverables.
* Monitor project risks, dependencies, and resource constraints and drive timely resolution.
* Facilitate project reviews and communicate status, key decisions, and risks to stakeholders and leadership.
* Support compliance with design controls, software lifecycle processes, risk management practices, and regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product quality and development efficiency.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Engineering, Science, or a related technical discipline.
* 5+ years of experience in program management, project management, software engineering, systems engineering, quality engineering, or related technical roles.
* Experience leading or supporting software development projects with cross-functional teams.
* Understanding of software development lifecycles and project execution methodologies.
* Experience managing project schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business functions.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).
* Experience with connected medical devices, digital health platforms, mobile applications, cloud-based healthcare solutions, or remote patient management technologies.
* Experience working in a regulated medical device or healthcare environment.
* Familiarity with IEC 62304 (Medical Device Software – Software Life Cycle Processes), ISO 14971, FDA software guidance, cybersecurity requirements, and design control processes.
* Experience supporting integrated hardware and software product development programs.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or hybrid software development methodologies.
* Background in software engineering, systems engineering, design quality, or product development.
* PMP, Agile, Scrum Master, or equivalent certifications.

**Apply Now**

Learn more about our health and wellness benefits, which provide the security to help you and your family live full lives: www.abbottbenefits.com

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at www.abbott.com, on Facebook at www.facebook.com/Abbott, and on Twitter @AbbottNews.

The base pay for this position is $114,000.00 – $228,000.00. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

jobs.title: IRT Project Manager, Remote US
jobs.description:
**Job Overview:**

  

The IRT Project Manager is accountable for the client’s study specific Interactive Response Technology (IRT) implementation, ongoing conduct support, closeout and decommission. Provides subject matter expertise, leads study specific implementation, ensures on time delivery, and remediation of support issues.

  

**Summary of Responsibilities** **:**

  

* Lead study-specific IRT Implementation Teams, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders including Clinical Trial Supply, Global Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, and vendors.

* Create and manage IRT-related timelines and deliverables.

* Conduct internal review meetings for vendor-written specifications and integration documents.

* Plan, facilitate, and lead IRT study review meetings.

* Ensure completion and approval of all IRT documentation, including specifications.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the IRT vendor for study-specific matters.

* Ensure compliance with relevant regulations such as GxPs and ICH E6.

* Provide guidance to the IRT Implementation Team on optimal system utilization.

* Act as a subject matter expert on IRT best practices and share lessons learned across teams.

* Define and complete initial documentation for scope of work requests from vendors.

* Review and provide expert input on User Requirement Specifications and other IRT-related documents.

* Review and approve UAT schedules aligned with URS.

* Create study-specific IRT Test Plans and test scripts.

* Facilitate UAT execution, coordinate issue resolution with vendors, and ensure proper documentation.

* Define and oversee data exchange requirements between IRT and other systems.

* Collaborate with stakeholders to determine integration solutions.

* Manage initial and ongoing testing to ensure efficient and error-free data transfers.

* Guide study teams on site-initiated data changes and vendor implementation.

* Facilitate collection of closeout deliverables from IRT vendors.

* Maintain a study-specific issue and risk log, documenting root causes, corrective actions, and preventive measures.

* Advise on system changes post-launch to ensure alignment with study and program needs.

* Manage study-specific IRT contracts, budgets, and change orders.

* Support the Global IRT Lead in process governance and standardization.

* Maintain consistency in IRT terminology, functionality, and reporting across studies.

* Assist in metrics collection and reporting.

* Recommend improvements to quality procedures and best practices.

* Conduct or develop IRT-related training for internal teams.

* Foster collaboration across internal stakeholders including Clinical Trial Supplies, eClinical Technology, Global Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, Clinical Quality, Regulatory, and Outsourcing.

* Provide regular updates to the Line Manager and escalate issues as needed.

* Perform all other duties as needed or assigned.

  

**Qualifications (Minimum Required):**

  

* University / college degree (life sciences, health sciences, information technology or related subjects preferred) or a certification in allied health professions from an appropriate accredited institution.

* Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

* Fluent in English, both written and verbal.

  

**Experience (Minimum Required):**

  

* 5–6 years of relevant experience in clinical systems project management, with a strong focus on or IRT and/or eCOA platforms

* Hands-on experience in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including planning, execution, defect tracking, and system go-live support.

* Proven ability to manage outsourced technology vendors and collaborate with sponsors and cross-functional teams.

* Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive and detail-oriented approach to issue resolution and system validation.

* Effective oral and written communication skills for stakeholder engagement, documentation, and reporting.

* Solid understanding of the clinical trial lifecycle, including system implementation, data flow, regulatory compliance, and TMF documentation.

* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment with minimal supervision.

* Strong time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to meet tight deadlines while maintaining high-quality standards.

* Demonstrated self-motivation, accountability, and ownership of assigned tasks.

* A cooperative and team-oriented mindset, with a willingness to support peers and contribute to shared goals.

  

**Pay Range:** $110,000-$125,000

  
  

**Benefits:** All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data. Regular, full-time or part-time employees working 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(K), Paid time off (PTO) or Flexible time off (FTO), Company bonus where applicable.

  
  

**Application Deadline:** 11/10/2026

The role designs governance, implementation plans, performance measures, communication strategies, and change-management approaches for initiatives involving study start-up, regulatory operations, clinical trial finance, research billing compliance, participant access and accrual, workforce models, and research technology. The Project Manager coordinates project resources and stakeholders to achieve timely, compliant, and financially responsible delivery while supporting a consistent investigator and participant experience.

Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization’s values of **Compassion**, **Accountability**, **Respect**, and **Excellence** as these values guide our everyday actions with patients, customers, and one another.

In addition to our values, all employees are expected to demonstrate the core Success Factors which tell us how we work together and how we get things done. The core Success Factors include:

* Instill Trust and Value Differences
* Patient and Community Focus and Collaborate

--------------------

jobs.title: Epic Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

With direction and support from the Epic Program Manager, the Epic Project Manager will manage Epic-related projects and initiatives supporting the ongoing success and maintenance of the electronic health record system and integrated third-party vendors. Projects include Epic application and third-party vendor implementations, optimizations as well as build and training efforts supporting new Central Health system service lines and locations.

The Epic Project Manager will work closely with the Epic Application Analyst Team, Epic Training Team, Business Intelligence Teams and system-wide Project Management Offices, as well as operational and clinical leaders, to implement, monitor, and improve Epic-related initiatives.

As a member of the Epic Project Management Office, core expectations will include adhering to and optimizing standardized approaches to project management, including but not limited to, developing and maintaining project schedules, controlling scope, monitoring budget, identifying and mitigating risks, and serving as a strategic thinking partner within the project team.

The Epic Project Manager will also coordinate ongoing Epic workgroups, which are responsible for Epic change requests and optimizations, new feature review and prioritization during upgrades, and issue mitigation. Epic Project Managers may be involved in additional project/programmatic efforts as needed. These responsibilities should be completed in a manner consistent with Central Health's mission.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Functions**

* Manage and coordinate projects to include establishing and implementing work plans, leading activities of various workgroups, and managing day-to-day operational aspects of a project.
* Work with project team members or subject matter experts to define project scope, goals, resource requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
* Continually monitor and report project progress to stakeholders, identifying risk points, and proposing solutions or escalating to leadership as needed.
* Create, maintain, and update key project documentation in a timely manner, including risk registers, change logs, and meeting notes.
* Maintain strong organization across projects and escalate sudden project changes including changes to timeline, resources, or scope, in a timely manner.
* Develop and maintain a working knowledge of existing operations and workstreams to maximize coordination and efficiency across Epic-related projects.
* Participate in strategic or operational planning exercises for the Central Health system as needed.
* Collaborate with multiple functional areas across the organization to gather operational requirements, improve processes, and influence operations as they pertain to assigned projects.
* Engage with operations to prepare for adoption of Epic optimizations and enhancements.
* Manage the day-to-day work of the Epic workgroups including reviewing change requests, vetting of new feature releases, and guiding evaluation of operational considerations and readiness.
* Serve as resource person/liaison between Epic team members, system-wide PMOs, and clinical/operational team members.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

**MINIMUM EDUCATION:** Bachelors Degree required

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:**

* 3 years of Epic and/or IT project management with a bachelor’s degree **OR**
* 1 of Epic and/or IT project management with a master’s degree

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
***Maximize your potential. Minimize your footprint.***

Nortek Data Center Cooling builds the systems that keep modern data centers running — from liquid cooling to large‑scale air solutions. Our work supports some of the world’s most demanding AI and hyperscale environments, and we solve those challenges with engineering depth and practical execution.

We keep things simple here. We communicate early, stay close to the details, and follow through. When issues come up, we address them directly, not with layers of process. Customers count on us because we do what we say and we keep projects moving.

Our culture is hands‑on and collaborative. People take ownership, move quickly, and help each other. If you like working with teammates who are straightforward and accountable, you’ll feel at home.

With the backing of Madison Air, we have the scale, stability, and manufacturing footprint to support complex, high‑growth programs.

**Position Summary**

The Program Manager serves as the day-to-day cross-functional integrator and accountability mechanism for customer commitments on assigned programs at Nortek Data Center Cooling. This role drives flawless execution across the full program lifecycle—from opportunity identification through completion of product commissioning.

Reporting to the Vice President of Program Management, the Program Manager coordinates Engineering, Test, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Commercial, Finance, and Service teams to meet schedule, cost, quality, and customer commitments, while these functions continue to own execution within their respective areas. This is a hands-on execution role accountable for program-level P&L execution and customer commitments—delivering revenue, margin, cost, cash, schedule, change orders, and overall program performance. Success requires strong critical-path management, cross-functional influence, and clear communication with both internal stakeholders and external customers. The Program Manager maintains direct customer contact on program execution and is accountable for the financial health of the program, while the Sales Account Executive remains the primary customer contact and owns customer communication, negotiation, and pricing strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Program Execution & Schedule Management**
-------------------------------------------

* Own end-to-end execution of assigned customer programs from opportunity identification through completion of product commissioning.
* Build, maintain, and drive the integrated program schedule with a relentless focus on critical-path items and dependencies across engineering, procurement, fabrication, assembly, test, shipping, installation, and commissioning.
* Lead recurring program cadence meetings, ensuring clear ownership, decisions, and follow-through on action items.
* Coordinate engineering release, drawing approval cycles, long-lead procurement, fabrication, assembly, testing, customer acceptance, installation, and commissioning milestones per the standardized program workflow.
* Escalate schedule risks and cross-functional roadblocks promptly, with proposed mitigation paths.

**Customer Coordination & Communication**
-----------------------------------------

* Maintain direct customer contact on program execution matters, while the Sales Account Executive remains the primary customer point of contact and owns customer communication and negotiation.
* Provide clear, proactive, and honest program status communications—schedule, milestones, risks, and change orders—to internal leadership and, in coordination with the Sales Account Executive, to the customer.
* Build strong working relationships with customer counterparts; understand their pain points, priorities, and success metrics.
* Represent the voice of the customer inside Nortek DCC and the voice of Nortek DCC to the customer with balance and integrity.

**Program-Level P&L and Contract Management**
---------------------------------------------

* Accountable for the financial health of the program and for program-level P&L execution and customer commitments—delivering revenue, margin, cost, cash, schedule, change orders, and overall program performance against the approved deal model and budget. Sales remains responsible for pricing strategy.
* Manage change orders end-to-end—identify scope changes, quantify impact, and drive internal approvals and execution—partnering with the Sales Account Executive, who leads customer negotiation.
* Monitor contract obligations, deliverables, and customer commitments; ensure Nortek DCC meets its obligations.
* Proactively identify risks to program profitability and partner with Commercial, Finance, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Service to mitigate them.

**Risk Management**
-------------------

* Apply the standardized risk identification, escalation, and mitigation process to every assigned program.
* Maintain a live program risk register with clear ownership, mitigation actions, due dates, and status.
* Drive critical risks to closure on time, targeting 90%+ on-time closure across the program portfolio.
* Escalate top risks to the VP of Program Management with recommended actions; ensure high-risk issues have documented mitigation plans and appropriate visibility.

**Installation, Commissioning & Service Coordination**
------------------------------------------------------

* Ensure Service has visibility to installation schedules and customer requirements.
* Ensure field resources, parts, and support plans are aligned with program commitments.
* Coordinate and escalate warranty issues, field modifications, or customer concerns.
* Track financial and customer impacts associated with post-delivery issues.

* Remain engaged whenever there are material issues impacting customer commitments, schedule, economics, or customer satisfaction; support formal handoff to Service when programs are running smoothly.
* Service continues to own service

jobs.title: Customer Enablement Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Customer Enablement Program Manager**

**Location:** Remote (U.S.)  
**Travel:** Approximately 25-40% (bi-weekly travel to Pella facilities, customer events, regional meetings, training programs, and launch activities)

**Help Build the Future of Professional Customer Development at Pella**

Pella is seeking a highly capable business leader and program builder to lead the development, launch, and operational management of ProCX Academy, a strategic initiative designed to strengthen the capabilities, engagement, and long-term success of our professional contractor customers.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in creating structure from ambiguity, building programs from the ground up, and driving cross-functional execution. You'll have the opportunity to establish a new business capability, develop scalable operating processes, align stakeholders across the organization, and create measurable impact on customer growth, sales effectiveness, installation quality, and overall business performance.

Success in this role requires a unique blend of program management expertise, operational leadership, business acumen, and hands-on execution. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing strategy, managing timelines, leading diverse stakeholders, solving complex operational challenges, and rolling up their sleeves to ensure successful delivery.

**A Unique Opportunity for a Program Builder**

We're seeking an experienced Program Management and Business Operations leader to build and scale ProCX Academy, a new contractor education and certification program designed to accelerate customer growth, capability development, and business performance.

This role is responsible for creating the operating model, establishing governance, leading cross-functional execution, managing launch activities, and building the processes, partnerships, and performance measures needed to scale a new business capability. You'll work across Sales, Installation, Product, Marketing, Customer Experience, IT, Finance, HR, and Legal to bring strategy to life and create a sustainable program that delivers measurable business impact.

The ideal candidate has successfully launched complex programs, built operating processes from the ground up, managed multiple stakeholders and priorities, and thrives in environments where they can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. If you're energized by building something new, creating structure from ambiguity, and driving initiatives from concept through implementation, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a lasting impact at Pella.

**What You'll Do**

**Build and Launch New Programs**

* Lead the development, launch, and ongoing management of ProCX Academy.
* Create and implement the operating model, governance structure, processes, and performance framework needed to support long-term success.
* Develop launch plans, project timelines, milestones, resource requirements, risk mitigation plans, and implementation roadmaps.
* Drive pilot programs and scale successful initiatives across the business.

**Position Summary**

FedSync is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead its corporate Program Management Office (PMO). This is an enterprise-level role overseeing a portfolio of federal contracts, not a single project. The role reports to executive leadership and partners with Business Development, Contracts, Finance and HR to shape FedSync's growth. **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the corporate PMO and provide executive oversight of all FedSync federal contracts and task orders.

* Recruit, develop and mentor Program and Project Managers; build a bench of Key Personnel for future bids.
* Partner with Business Development on capture and proposals: solution design, staffing plans, pricing input and past performance.
* Lead new-contract transitions and recompete readiness across the portfolio.
* Ensure company-wide compliance with FAR/DFARS, quality, security and audit requirements; drive strong CPARS ratings.
* Report portfolio health and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Engineering, IT or a related field.
* 12+ years of professional experience, including 7+ years managing federal government contracts or programs.
* Demonstrated success leading multiple concurrent programs or a portfolio with combined value of $25M+ and 50+ staff.
* Experience with P&L management, financial forecasting and contract-level cost controls.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.
* Executive-level communication skills, including briefing senior government and corporate leaders.

* Master's degree (MBA, MPM or related).

jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Amentum is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. Our people apply undaunted curiosity, relentless ambition and boundless imagination to challenge convention and drive progress. Our commitments are underpinned by the belief that safety, collaboration and well-being are integral to success. Headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, we have approximately 50,000 employees in more than 70 countries across all 7 continents.

The **Senior Cybersecurity Risk Analyst** is a US remote, senior individual contributor position within the Cybersecurity Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GR&C) team. This role owns the enterprise's cyber risk assessment work: evaluating activities and operational decisions across the enterprise and articulating the resulting cyber risk to business leadership against the enterprise's risk appetite.

The work is assessment heavy. The Senior Cybersecurity Risk Analyst examines technology and operational decisions for cyber risk that compliance-driven review alone does not surface, then frames that risk in business terms so GR&C and leaders can make informed accept, mitigate, or remediate decisions. The role is a twin to the Compliance function: where Compliance concentrates on the administrative work of demonstrating conformance to mandatory controls, this role works alongside it to drive cohesive cyber risk management across the enterprise regardless of which framework imposes a given requirement.

Consistent with the GR&C charter, the role helps protect Amentum against internal and external cyber threats and helps set, improve, and make recommendations on the enterprise security program based on industry best practices, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. GR&C surfaces and advises on risk so that business and operational owners can make informed decisions. This person must be technical enough to recognize risk in networking, cloud, endpoint, and identity decisions made by engineering and IT, and credible enough that their risk judgments carry weight with those teams and with leadership. The role acts on behalf of the entire enterprise rather than any single team, contract, or project, and brings attention to risk without hindering the business. **This position is US remote telework and requires US Citizenship.**

**Essential Responsibilities**
==============================

* Conduct cyber risk assessments of activities and operational decisions across the enterprise, identifying risk to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of enterprise systems and data.
* Articulate cyber risk to business and technical leadership in clear, decision-ready terms, framed against the enterprise's risk appetite.
* Take lead on cyber risk reviews across a range of assessment types, such as third-party cyber risk assessment, temporary risk acceptance review, and software risk review, and track enterprise artificial intelligence development as it relates to cyber risk.
* Work with the Compliance function to ensure that mandatory control interpretations do not leave other cyber risk unaddressed, and that risk treatment is coherent across frameworks.
* Evaluate the cyber risk implications of technology decisions, recognizing risk in networking, cloud, endpoint, and identity and access architectures that compliance-only review would not surface.
* Articulate when residual cyber risk exceeds the enterprise's appetite and specify the risk reduction required.
* Contribute a risk-posture perspective to enterprise scoping and architecture decisions, including the residual risk implications of carved-out certification environments and enclave boundaries.
* Improve the operational and procedural aspects of the Cyber GR&C function: assessment methodology, intake, risk articulation standards, evidence handling, and the consistency of risk judgments across the team.
* Maintain current knowledge of the cyber risk, threat, technology, and regulatory landscape, and bring that currency into assessments and into the team's collective capability.
* Travel up to 25 percent. Perform other position-related duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**
=================================

* Demonstrated ability to recognize cyber risk in networking, cloud, and endpoint technologies, and in identity and access management, well enough to assess the decisions of engineering and IT teams independently.
* Ability to articulate cyber risk to business leadership in decision-ready terms.
* Working knowledge of NIST publications and their relevance to cyber risk and compliance.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical risk to non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-starter able to operate autonomously on ambiguous problems with limited direction.
* Ability to travel up to 25 percent.

**Minimum Requirements**
========================

* Typically 8 years of hands-on cybersecurity experience, with demonstrated depth in evaluating real technology environments, not solely policy or audit administration with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related field plus; or 4 years with Master's
* Demonstrated experience in enterprise risk management and in third-party or vendor cyber risk assessment.

* Current Security+ or an equivalent industry certification. (Certification establishes the baseline; demonstrated hands-on capability is weighted more heavily than credentials.)
* Must be a U.S. Citizen.
* U.S. Remote-Telework role; must reside within the United States to work remotely.

jobs.description:
**About Rhythm Energy**
-----------------------

Rhythm is a renewable energy and technology company on a mission to make clean energy simple, accessible, and affordable for everyone.

We combine deep energy market expertise with technology, design, and data science to deliver innovative, transparent, and customer-centric energy solutions. From helping customers take control of their electricity choices to developing new products and technologies that support a more sustainable energy future, we're rethinking how people interact with energy.

We're a fast-growing, mission-driven team that values ownership, collaboration, and innovation. We move quickly, challenge conventional thinking, and empower our people to solve meaningful problems and make a real impact.

At Rhythm, you'll have the opportunity to help shape the future of energy while building products, systems, and experiences that make a difference for our customers.

The analyst is as a liaison between the business units and business intelligence developers to understand, analyze and document requirements for business intelligence solutions including reports, visualizations, data warehouse and the multi-dimensional cube. The analyst will also test and validate the solutions to ensure quality and customer expectations are met. jobs.description:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Technical Program Manager, Data to join our Technical PMO team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

  

**About the role:**

Lead the data transformation at the core of realizing better healthcare for millions of people.

Oscar is hiring a Technical Program Manager to join our Tech PMO, dedicated to a major enterprise data transformation. You'll partner closely with Data leadership to lead migration from planning through delivery, protecting the quality and integrity of the data our teams rely on every day.

We're looking for someone who has experience partnering with Data teams and leading a major enterprise data migration and who brings curiosity, initiative, and sound judgment. You can engage deeply with business partners, data scientists, data engineers, make complex dependencies and tradeoffs clear, and help leaders make timely decisions. You take ownership of execution while building trust with the people who produce and use the data.  
Your program will include revamping our data transformation and semantic layers, as well as evolving our data governance and data quality capabilities across the entire business. You'll coordinate Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Scientists, Analysts, and business owners through migration, validation, adoption, and operational handoff.

You'll have the opportunity to shape how Oscar delivers enterprise data programs and help build a strong TPM team. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of the Tech PMO, partnering closely with Data leadership. You'll lead technical program execution, with Data Engineering accountable for architecture and implementation.

You will report into the Director, Technical Program Management.

**Work Location:** This position is based in our New York City office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid

**Pay Transparency:** The base pay for this role is: $117,576 - $154,319 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, and annual performance bonuses.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the integrated enterprise data migration plan from scoping through delivery and operational handoff, with clear owners, migration waves, milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Turn ambiguity into action across dbt migration, Cube implementation, data governance, and data quality workstreams. Bring the right owners together and resolve gaps in scope, sequencing, and readiness.
* Partner with Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Scientists, Analysts, and business owners to map upstream and downstream dependencies, coordinate commitments, and make scope, sequencing, and capacity tradeoffs explicit.
* Anticipate migration risks and drive timely decisions. Escalate with clear options, recommendations, and impact on data quality, integrity, reporting, and business continuity.
* Coordinate data reconciliation, testing, cutover and rollback plans, adoption, and operational readiness. Ensure technical and business owners agree on validation evidence, go/no-go criteria, and required security, privacy, and compliance reviews.
* Support program planning and give Data and executive leaders a clear view of migration progress, readiness, unresolved decisions, and outcomes. Drive business acceptance and clear operational ownership for migrated domains.
* Help build a strong TPM team: share useful practices, challenge unnecessary processes, support colleagues, and turn lessons from delivery into improvements.
* Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years of technical program or project management/process-oriented operations work experience.
* 2+ years of experience using coding languages such as SQL to analyze project performance and risks and develop erports for management and business owners.
* Experience independently leading complex software development programs across multiple teams, from planning through launch and operational handoff.
* Technical fluency in data pipelines, transformation layers, data models, semantic layers, lineage, and integrations, with the judgment to challenge migration plans, validation approaches, and implementation tradeoffs.
* Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous enterprise programs, manage cross-domain dependencies and competing priorities, and coordinate data validation, cutover readiness, and business continuity.
* A record of building trust and influencing decisions across Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Scientists, Analysts, and business owners, and executive stakeholders without direct authority.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate technical migration risks into business impact and recommend a course of action to senior leaders.
* Strong ownership and follow-through, with examples of moving work forward when plans change or obstacles arise.

**Bonus points:**

* Experience in healthcare, health insurance, or another regulated industry.
* Experience with dbt and Cube, or comparable transformation and semantic-layer technologies.
* Experience implementing data governance, data quality controls, lineage, or consistent business metric definitions across domains.
* Experience coordinating external vendors and helping business and analytics teams adopt new data platforms and ways of working.
* Experience migrating business-critical analytics or reporting with staged validation, reconciliation, cutover, and rollback practice

**Description**

### **Illuminate Emerging Adversary Campaigns Across the Pacific Cyberspace Frontier**

Leidos is seeking an experienced, analytical **Cyber Threat Analyst** to join our Defensive Cyber Operations (DCO) team supporting Defense Information Systems Agency Pacific (DISA PAC) at Ford Island, Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam, HI. Operating under the Global Services Management – Operations II (GSM-O II) Task Order 22 (TN22) Boundary Cyber Defense and Cybersecurity Services Provider (CSSP) contract, our mission is to defend the Department of Defense Information Network (DODIN/DISN), U.S. Pacific Command (USPACOM), and critical mission partner enclaves against sophisticated advanced persistent threats and nation-state cyber actors.

In this high-impact intelligence and analysis role, you will synthesize multi-source intelligence, telemetry, and forensic data into actionable threat intelligence. You will analyze adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), formulate threat indicators, track advanced adversary campaigns, and direct threat-informed defense operations across perimeter boundaries, multi-cloud platforms, and classified networks—spanning Unclassified (NIPRNet) and Secret (SIPRNet) up to Top Secret/SCI.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **1. Boundary Threat Analysis & Adversary Characterization**

* **Warning Intelligence & Attack Sensing:** Analyze boundary sensor feeds, Netflow, and IDS/IPS logs in conjunction with intelligence agencies, peer CSSPs, and commercial intelligence providers to deliver Warning Intelligence and Attack Sensing and Warning activities compliant with DoDI 8530.01.
* **Adversary Campaign Tracking:** Apply the **MITRE ATT&CK®** and Cyber Kill Chain frameworks to characterize adversary behavior, track campaign evolution, identify "Living off the Land" (LotL) tradecraft, and assess the operational impact of targeted threats traversing enterprise Internet Access Points and Boundary Cloud Access Points.
* **Actionable Battlefield Intelligence:** Author, refine, and disseminate high-impact, actionable battlefield cyber threat analysis products, Threat Warnings, and Tippers that empower tactical defenders and boundary engineers to preempt emerging cyber assaults.
* **Automated Telemetry & Breach Assessment:** Evaluate bypasses and telemetry from automated blocking platforms to uncover adversary evasion techniques, evaluate malicious patterns, and generate targeted analytic hypotheses.
* **Operational Reporting & DJOC Synchronization:** Coordinate closely with the DISA Joint Operations Center (DJOC), USPACOM J6, DoD Cyber Defense Command (DCDC), USCYBERCOM, and the National Security Agency (NSA) to synchronize threat analyses and maintain standardized incident reporting in the DoD-mandated reporting structure (currently Rally).

### **2. Enterprise CSSP Intelligence & Proactive Threat Hunting**

* **Deliberate Defense (DD) & Discovery Counter Infiltration (DCI):** Formulate threat hypotheses based on all-source intelligence, reconstruct multi-stage adversary attack paths, and conduct structured threat-hunting across enterprise endpoints and cloud enclaves to validate malicious presence or confirm its absence.
* **Multi-Cloud & Zero Trust Threat Analysis:** Track advanced persistent threats operating against enterprise cloud ecosystems (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, Google Cloud Platform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) secured under the Joint Warfighter Cloud Capability, Thunderdome Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and Microsoft Defender suite (EndGuard).
* **Analytic Capability & Use Case Development:** Translate threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into specific detection use cases, rule logic, and detection requirements for ingestion into enterprise SIEMs (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, and JCRS-D).
* **Aggregated Threat Trend Reporting:** Aggregate threat indicators, malware behaviors, and adversary profiles from commercial threat feeds (e.g., CrowdStrike, VirusTotal) and internal investigations; provide inputs for the quarterly Aggregated Cyber Awareness Report detailing strategic threat forecasts and vulnerability exposures.
* **Vulnerability & Exposure Intelligence:** Continuously assess Information Assurance Vulnerability Management notices (IAVAs and IAVBs) against active adversary exploitation trends, providing technical threat context and impact assessments to mission partner enclaves.

### **3. Location-Specific & Above-Secret Intelligence: PACOM & TS/SCI**

* **PACOM Mission Network (PMN) and Joint Operational Edge – Coalition Environment (JOE-CE) Threat Assessment:** Provide dedicated cyber threat intelligence and behavioral profiling tailored to the PMN and JOE-CE operational networks.
* **User & Entity Behavioral Profiling:** Analyze Identity, Credential, and Access Management telemetry and the PMN Master User Record to identify anomalous user behavior, insider threats, and sophisticated lateral movement.
* **SCIF-Based Intelligence Operations:** Conduct all-source cyber analysis within Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIF) at Ford Island, examining multi-discipline intelligence across JWICS, YLAN, and special-access enclaves up to Top Secret / SCI.
* **Cross-Echelon Coordination:** Brief Senior Executive and military leadership across USPACOM, DISA PAC, and operational mission partners on adversary threat capabilities, active campaigns, and strategic risk postures.

**What You’ll Need for Success**
--------------------------------

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience working on day to day site operations within industrial facilities (e.g., power plants, oil refineries, utilities, automotive or manufacturing).
Experience leading cyber security or technical programs.  

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Direct experience working in an operational control room or plant environment (e.g., manufacturing, utility/power generation, data center operations, or heavy industrial operations).
* Direct experience with cybersecurity initiatives, threat assessments, vulnerability management, or incident response within an industrial control systems (ICS) or Operational Technology (OT) environment.
* Experience with data analytics, SQL, dashboarding, or status reporting tools to track program metrics and communicate progress to leadership.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Data Center Central Operations is responsible for keeping these sites operating efficiently and safely. This role will provide the technical expertise and tactical site-specific support for innovation and continuous improvements to information security (e.g., PLCs, electrical switchgear and mechanical heavy equipment). The role will be responsible for working with numerous cross functional teams and stakeholders to implement a vision for innovative site security processes and technologies, as well as directly driving improvements across a basket of physical Data Center sites. Along with the rest of the Fleet Health team within DC Central Operations, you will work cross functionally with the larger Technical Infrastructure organization, collaborating with core teams in Global Server Operations, Supply Chain and Procurement, Data Center Operations, Advanced Technology and Innovation, DC Engineers, and other teams.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own information security programs for industrial equipment and facility assets within LATAM, while leading one or more OT security workstreams globally.
* Develop and drive program implementation, long-term strategy, cross-site execution, and resource prioritization for information security efforts across Google’s fleet of Data Centers in partnership with global engineering and regional teams.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to define/measure security postures, establish new business processes to proactively address weaknesses, and drive continuous improvements.
* Guide and optimize complex operational technology security programs to drive consistency, efficiency, and economies of scale across multiple teams, measuring success by direct impact on product area-level OKRs.
* Leverage control system insights and experience to influence and inform stakeholders across DC Central Operations, DC Software, and site-specific teams.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. With 1,000+ intelligence professionals serving over 1,900 clients worldwide, Recorded Future is the world's most advanced, and largest, intelligence company!

### **Threat Intelligence Analyst:** **Threat Research & Analysis (TR&A), Insikt Group, Recorded Future**

**This Role:** Recorded Future's Insikt Group is seeking a **Threat Intelligence Analyst** to join our Threat Research & Analysis (TR&A) team, focusing on tracking nation-state and cybercriminal threat actors and the emerging cyber threats that matter most to our clients. TR&A is a distributed team of experienced analysts monitoring, reporting on, and writing detections for state-sponsored and financially motivated threat actors.  
  
This role involves both proactive monitoring and in-depth research into threat actor infrastructure, tools, and TTPs, as well as producing high-impact, actionable finished intelligence and detections. You will track new and evolving nation-state and cyber threats as they emerge, adapting focus as the threat landscape and our clients' priorities shift.

**What You'll Do:**

* Conduct proactive hunting for threat actors by establishing methods to identify, signature, and validate malicious infrastructure;
* Conduct technical research into nation-state and cybercriminal threat actors, dissecting their tools and TTPs to produce high-impact finished intelligence for clients and the Recorded Future public blog;
* Represent Insikt Group as a subject matter expert through customer briefings, media engagements, and public research dissemination, focusing on malicious infrastructure and regional threat landscapes;
* Collaborate with geopolitical and regional analysis teams to support cross-functional research
* Mentor and guide analysts within the team, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing, skill development, and professional growth, ensuring the team's collective expertise is continually advancing.
* Continuously improve and optimize threat intelligence processes, tools, and methodologies to enhance the team's ability to detect and respond to emerging threats, and proactively identify opportunities for automation and efficiency gains.
* Stay up to date on evolving Threat Actor tradecraft and the global malware landscape by monitoring technical publications, blogs, and trusted sharing communities.

* A passion for threat hunting and threat intelligence.
* Demonstrative understanding of malicious infrastructure detection to include C2s, botnets, etc., in the context of cybersecurity, pivoting, network defense, and business risk.
* Ability to leverage AI/LLMs to automate "busy work" and accelerate workflows while maintaining the rigorous human-in-the-loop required to ensure high-fidelity, verified intelligence.
* Demonstrable experience conducting technical threat analysis and research
* Demonstrable experience with structured analytical techniques, the intelligence cycle, and intelligence writing techniques and methodologies

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proficiency in a foreign language (Arabic, Turkish or Persian/Farsi) to support regional-specific research;
* MA/MS or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Security, or a related field
* Scripting capabilities (Python preferred)
* Experience writing network and/or endpoint signature detections using Suricata, Snort, YARA, SIGMA, etc.

* Develops, recommends, and maintains the DCAA Data, Analytics, and AI Strategy. This includes creating associated governance, compliance, and implementation plans, and aligning them with the agency's mission and strategic plan.
* Exercises first-level supervision over four GS-14 Branch Chiefs and second-level supervision over the subordinate workforce. This includes planning work, setting priorities, evaluating performance, and managing personnel actions.
* Plans, organizes, and directs the integrated CDAO portfolio. This duty involves establishing priorities, roadmaps, and resource requirements, and overseeing enterprise data and analytics capabilities, automation, and AI initiatives.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* Selective Service: Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered or be exempt from Selective Service (see http://www.sss.gov/)Employment
* Eligibility Verification (E-Verify) Program: DCAA uses E-Verify to determine eligibility for employment as a U.S. Citizen.

* Pay for first time hires to the Federal Government will typically be set at step 1 salary range for their respective grade level.

### **Qualifications**

One year of specialized experience equivalent in level of difficulty and responsibility to that of the next lower grade, GS-14, within the federal service, which demonstrates the ability to perform the duties of the position, is required.
  
  
**Specialized experience is defined as:** Specialized experience includes formulating and championing enterprise-wide digital, data, or artificial intelligence strategies that align advanced technical capabilities with organizational mission goals and governance frameworks; OR directing a complex program portfolio of advanced technology or automation initiatives, which includes establishing performance metrics, evaluating life-cycle risks, and managing resources through a tiered organizational structure of subordinate supervisors; OR leading executive-level stakeholder engagement and coalition building to negotiate agreements, drive cultural adoption of digital capabilities, and represent your organization as a principal advisor on high-profile panels.
  
  
**Definition of Well Qualified:** Experience establishing and executing enterprise-wide governance, strategic plans, and performance metrics for a complex portfolio consisting of data, analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives; Managing, justifying, and executing multi-million dollar program budgets, and dynamically redirecting financial and personnel resources to meet shifting agency or organizational priorities; Supervising and leading a multidisciplinary workforce, including directing the work of subordinate supervisors, establishing performance standards,
  
and managing personnel actions; Integrating technical, legal, and cybersecurity risk parameters to make authoritative recommendations and drive strategic decision-making across competing business units; Leading complex change management initiatives to overcome barriers to modern technology adoption and scaling enterprise-wide digital capabilities.
  
  
**Volunteer Experience:** Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

### **Education**

**Education is not substitutable for specialized experience for this position**

### **Additional information**

* DCAA has a comprehensive benefits package that includes retirement, social security and thrift savings; health, life and long term care insurance; paid vacation, sick leave and holidays. DCAA employees enjoy our business-casual dress code, flexible work schedules and transit subsidies.
* This position **is not**covered by a bargaining unit.
* This position is exempt from the Fair Labor Standards Act.
* **Additional Vacancies:** This announcement may be used to fill additional positions within 90 days of the closing date.

This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

  

At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission you’ll define it. Lead the work that keeps America flying safely.

If you thrive in environments where precision matters, collaboration is essential, and your work has national significance, this role offers both challenge and purpose.

  

**Work Location:**

* Track project progress against established milestones, KPIs, contractual requirements, and customer expectations.

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

Forward Deployed Business Analyst

**Your team**

The BlackRock Transformation Office (BTO) is a global group of change professionals that delivers strategic transformation to help make BlackRock greater than the sum of its parts. We drive 1BLK outcomes by continuously connecting and being students of the firm’s people, processes and technology.

We are a versatile team with varied experiences and backgrounds, motivated by the challenge of finding solutions that benefit BlackRock and our clients. In BTO, we focus on developing our people, strengthening leadership and delivery skills, and broadening firm and industry knowledge. Projects and roles consider both successful delivery and individual development objectives and career aspirations.

**Your role and impact**

The Forward Deployed Business Analyst will work in cross-functional teams to reimagine, innovate and scale solutions that drive growth and operating models within the firm.

This is not a traditional business analysis role centered on gathering requirements and handing them to technology. The role combines business analysis, product discovery, business architecture and hands-on prototyping to turn ambiguous problems into tangible solutions that business users and engineers can test and refine together.

Successful candidates will combine the structured thinking of a business analyst, the prioritization instincts of a product owner, the enterprise perspective of a business architect and the bias to action of a hands-on builder.

**Your responsibilities**

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

* Take ownership of complex, ambiguous business problems and rapidly translate them into testable solution hypotheses with measurable outcomes.
* Build structured business context covering terminology, entities, relationships, decision logic, data dependencies, controls and exceptions for use by subject matter experts, AI tools and engineering teams.
* Decompose business processes into explicit logic, controls and exception paths for implementation by technology teams.
* Create functional prototypes using AI-enabled development capabilities to discover requirements, challenge assumptions and validate future-state processes, data, policies and controls.
* Shape the target operating model, including ownership of data, governance, controls, roles and exception management.
* Partner continuously with business experts, product managers, engineers, architects, data specialists and control partners from discovery through implementation.
* **Develop measurable project objectives, drive consensus, and communicate plans, progress and outcomes effectively to stakeholders and management across levels.**

**Your experience**

* 3–5 years of relevant work experience in transformation, product delivery, business architecture, technology-enabled change or a comparable discipline.
* Experience in business architecture and operating-model design, connecting solutions to business capabilities, roles, governance, policy ownership, controls and exception handling.
* Proficiency in prototype-led problem solving and rapidly converting ambiguous business problems into functional prototypes that stakeholders can see, test and challenge.
* Expertise using AI-enabled development environments to accelerate analysis, prototyping, requirements definition and testing, including critically evaluating generated outputs, maintaining traceability and understanding where human judgment remains essential.
* Experience with iterative delivery and hands-on ownership through cycles of analysis, experimentation and solution shaping.
* Experience in financial services or a similar industry.

**Job Description**

Key Responsibilities

Privacy Program Management & Reporting

* Structure and maintain privacy operations work in Azure DevOps (ADO), Jira, or similar work-management tools, including custom work item types and fields mapped to privacy concepts (jurisdiction, data type, risk tier).

* Build and maintain KPI dashboards and reporting (e.g., DSAR SLA compliance, assessment backlog age, incident response times) for privacy program leadership, using ADO Analytics, Power BI, or similar tools.

* Track cross-functional privacy work items that depend on Legal, Security, and Product teams, and proactively surface bottlenecks and at-risk items.

* Coordinate responses to data subject access requests (DSARs) and other data subject rights requests, ensuring timely resolution within statutory timelines across jurisdictions.

Track and report on privacy program metrics and KPIs for leadership and relevant stakeholders.  



Privacy Risk Assessments

* Conduct and document privacy impact assessments (PIAs), data protection impact assessments (DPIAs), and transfer impact assessments (TIAs) for new products, features, and vendor engagements.

* Support automated assessment workflows that trigger and assign PIAs/DPIAs based on risk-based conditional logic (data type, processing purpose, jurisdiction, vendor risk tier), escalating high-risk triggers for senior review.

Support efforts to reduce manual effort in assessment scoring and risk rating, applying sound judgment on what can be automated versus what must remain human-reviewed.  



Data Mapping & ROPA Maintenance

* Maintain and update the company’s records of processing activities (ROPA), tying outputs directly to data mapping and risk assessment findings.

* Support data discovery and data flow mapping efforts across the organization’s systems, environments, and third-party integrations, leveraging data discovery tooling where available.

Support an ongoing ownership and maintenance model for the data map/ROPA, including monitoring for drift as systems or vendors change and reconciling against discovery tool outputs.  



Privacy Compliance & Risk Management

* Monitor and track changes in privacy regulations across jurisdictions, and support compliance with key regulations including UK GDPR/EU GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, and other applicable regimes.

* Support privacy incident response and breach notification processes, including incident documentation and breach register maintenance.

Support privacy audits and assessments of internal processes and third-party vendors.  



Privacy-by-Design & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Support the intake and triage of privacy-related inquiries from internal stakeholders and customers.

* Partner with Legal, Information Security, IT, Product, and Business teams to support the integration of privacy-by-design principles into the product development cycle.

* Assist with privacy training content delivery and tracking across the business.

Support vendor and partner reviews to ensure contractual privacy obligations are met, and help identify current sub-processors for contractual documentation updates.  



Documentation & Governance

* Contribute to internal privacy policy, procedure, and operational playbook documentation.

* Maintain privacy metrics, dashboards, and reports for leadership and relevant stakeholders.

Provide guidance and quality review to junior privacy operations team members on documentation and process adherence.  



Required Qualifications

* 5-7 years of experience in a privacy, compliance, legal operations, or similar role, supporting a global or multi-jurisdictional privacy program.

* Working knowledge of UK GDPR/EU GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, and other applicable global data subject rights frameworks.

* Hands-on experience with privacy management platforms (e.g., OneTrust, TrustArc) configuring or running DSAR, PIA/DPIA, and data mapping workflows.

* Experience using work-management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira) to structure and track privacy operations work, including building reporting dashboards and KPIs for leadership.

* Exposure to or experience with automation of privacy workflows (e.g., Power Automate, API integrations between privacy platforms and ticketing systems) to reduce manual effort in DSAR, assessment, and data mapping processes.

* Understanding of data discovery and data mapping tooling and techniques to keep ROPA records current and minimize drift.

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing multiple deadlines across time zones.

Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief stakeholders on program status and risk.  



Preferred Qualifications

* CIPP/E, CIPP/US, or CIPM certification, or actively pursuing.

* Experience building ADO/Jira custom work item types, boards, and Power BI or analytics dashboards for privacy KPI reporting.

* Experience with data discovery/classification tools (e.g., OneTrust Data Discovery, BigID, Collibra).

* Prior experience in a shared services, global operations, or multinational organization.

Your analytical approach and attention to detail will help maintain accurate, timely and high-quality reporting in a fast-paced, multi-jurisdictional environment. * Business analysis experience, including producing clear business and functional requirements, analysing and performing data mapping, transformation requirements and regulatory testing activities

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering assigned IT projects in accordance with FTA’s project governance framework, approved scope, schedule, budget, quality standards, and business objectives. The role manages project teams and stakeholders, monitors progress and risks, maintains project documentation and reporting, and escalates issues requiring management decisions.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Initiate and plan projects by defining objectives, scope, deliverables, milestones, resource requirements, dependencies, assumptions, and success measures.

* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, work breakdown structures, resource plans, budgets, and risk, issue, assumption, and dependency logs.

* Coordinate business owners, IT teams, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure clear responsibilities, timely decisions, and effective delivery.

* Monitor project performance against approved baselines; track milestones, costs, resources, deliverables, and benefits; and recommend corrective actions when variances arise.

* Prepare regular project status reports, dashboards, steering committee updates, and escalation papers using PMO-approved templates and tools.

* Identify, assess, manage, and escalate project risks, issues, dependencies, scope changes, and delivery blockers in line with PMO governance and change-control procedures.

* Manage vendor and outsourced team performance against agreed deliverables, service levels, contractual obligations, timelines, and quality expectations.

* Coordinate requirements, solution design, testing, user acceptance, deployment, transition to operations, and project closure, ensuring approvals and acceptance criteria are met.

* Maintain complete and accurate project documentation, decisions, approvals, lessons learned, and benefits-realisation information in the designated project management system.

* Ensure project activities comply with FTA policies, information security requirements, procurement and contract processes, and applicable regulatory obligations.

* Facilitate project meetings and workshops, follow up on actions, resolve conflicts, and communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels.

* Support portfolio reporting, resource planning, project prioritisation, and continuous improvement of PMO practices as required.

  
  
**Requirements**

Minimum:

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from PMI — mandatory and valid.

Preferred:

* Additional recognised certification in Agile, PRINCE2, programme/project management, business analysis, or risk management.

**Work Experience**

**Minimum:**

* At least 3 years of proven professional experience working as a Project Manager, with responsibility for planning and delivering projects end to end and 8+ overall experience.

* Experience managing project schedules, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, stakeholders, and project reporting.

* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and managing vendors or outsourced delivery teams.

**Preferred:**

* Experience delivering IT, digital transformation, systems implementation, or enterprise technology projects.

* Experience working within a formal PMO, project governance framework, and change-control process.

* Knowledge of project financial management, resource planning, procurement, and contract management.

**About the Opportunity:**

Melissa is looking for a curious, detail-oriented, and technically capable data professional to help maintain and improve the quality of some of our most important proprietary data assets. At Melissa, we develop data quality and identity solutions that help organizations maintain accurate, reliable, and connected information.

We are looking for someone to take a hands-on role in understanding, analyzing, validating, and continuously improving these identifiers. You will work directly with large datasets, investigate data anomalies, develop quality checks, evaluate changes, and collaborate with technical teams to ensure our identifiers remain accurate, consistent, and reliable. This is an opportunity to develop deep expertise in data quality, identity resolution, and large-scale data management while taking ownership of data assets used by Melissa's customers.

**What You Will Do:**

* Analyze and validate data for accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, and reliability.
* Investigate data anomalies, duplicate identifiers, unexpected key changes, incorrect matches, and other data-quality issues.
* Write SQL queries to compare datasets, identify patterns, investigate problems, and validate results.
* Develop repeatable data-quality checks, reports, and automated validation processes.
* Evaluate changes in data sources, matching rules, and data-processing procedures to identify potential impacts on identifier quality.
* Collaborate with Data Production, Programming, and Quality Assurance teams to investigate and resolve issues.
* Test and validate improvements, corrections, and new capabilities involving Melissa's identifiers.
* Monitor quality trends and recommend opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain documentation of findings, quality standards, known issues, and validation procedures.
* Help establish and maintain data-integrity metrics and reporting.

**What We Are Looking For:**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Ability to investigate complex data issues, identify patterns, and draw meaningful conclusions.
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow problems through to resolution.
* Experience working with data in an analytical, operational, or technical capacity.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2 or more years of relevant experience in data analysis, data quality, data operations, or a related field.
* Experience working with large datasets.
* Familiarity with AI, Python or other scripting tools for data analysis and automation.
* Understanding of data matching, deduplication, entity resolution, or master data management.
* Experience with data profiling, data validation, or quality monitoring.
* Familiarity with ETL processes, APIs, or data-processing pipelines.
* Experience investigating production data issues and evaluating changes between data releases.

**Who Will Succeed in This Role?**
