Votre mission principale sera de guider les prises de décisions en matière d'optimisation des parcours client, d'amélioration de la productivité et suivi de la performance, tout en soutenant la croissance et optimisant la productivité de nos call centers en lien avec le plan stratégique de l'entreprise.

Votre expertise technique Databricks combinée à la compréhension de l'environnement opérationnel, des process et de nos outils de la relation client sera clé pour réaliser des analyses pertinentes et fiables, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers et data.

Vous occuperez également le rôle de référent technique Databricks de l'équipe, accompagnant la migration vers Unity Catalog, l'évolution des pipelines et les bonnes pratiques de développement.

**Vos missions :**

* Assurer le suivi de production des indicateurs au quotidien
* Accompagner la mise en place de nouveaux indicateurs pertinents du suivi opérationnel en collaboration avec les sites opérationnels et les équipes métiers
* Enrichir l’environnement existant dans le respect des standards de programmation

* Identifier les axes d’amélioration et les drivers de sous/ sur performance afin d’aider les équipes à construire leur plan d’actions.

* Définir et suivre les indicateurs de succès et anticiper les risques, notamment dans la cadre de notre stratégie de contact ;
* Formaliser des scenarii de décision et des préconisations pour faciliter la prise de décision ;

**R****éférent technique Data**

* Être le point focal technique sur les sujets Databricks, pipeline engineering et bonnes pratiques DevOps de l'équipe
* Piloter la migration des notebook Databricks vers Unity Catalog : définir la stratégie, planifier les étapes, valider la conformité et les performances
* Établir et maintenir les standards de développement des pipelines (code review, testing, documentation, versioning)
* Supporter et former l'équipe aux nouvelles technologies et pratiques post-migration
* Anticiper les risques techniques et proposer des solutions d'optimisation et de scalabilité

----------------

Vous êtes un professionnel **passionné par la data**, avec au moins **5 ans d'expérience, idéalement dans le conseil en management des organisations et des systèmes d’information.**

Vos compétences analytiques, organisationnelles et votre approche pragmatique sont des atouts précieux.

Votre aisance relationnelle pour échanger régulièrement avec d’autres équipes (techniques ou non techniques) et fructifier concrètement chacun de ces échanges sont essentiels.

Une connaissance du **secteur de l’assurance** serait un plus.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Lancée en 2021 avec l’ambition de devenir l’insurtech européenne de référence sur le risque cyber, Stoïk est soutenue par certains des investisseurs les plus renommés au monde et a co-construit son produit d’assurance avec des assureurs et des réassureurs de premier plan, tels que Tokio Marine HCC et Swiss Re.

Stoïk protège et assure aujourd’hui plus de 14 000 entreprises dans 7 pays européens, avec une équipe de plus de 180 collaborateurs. Notre modèle va au-delà de l’assurance cyber : nous associons la couverture à nos propres outils de sécurité, à une surveillance 24h/24 et à une équipe interne de réponse à incident qui traite plus de 150 incidents par mois. Notre mission : être le CISO de l’Europe.

**Le poste**
------------

Nous recherchons un ou une Data Analyst pour rejoindre notre équipe data. Le cœur du poste consiste à créer et à maintenir les graphiques, les chiffres et les rapports qui décrivent l’activité de l’entreprise.

* En tant que startup en forte croissance, Stoïk ajuste en permanence sa stratégie commerciale au rythme du lancement de nouveaux produits et de l’ouverture de nouveaux marchés. Les nouvelles fonctionnalités de notre logiciel ont besoin d’indicateurs pour être évaluées. L’analyse de données est donc nécessaire aussi bien pour mesurer le succès du plan en cours que pour préparer le suivant.
* Parce qu’elle commercialise des contrats d’assurance, l’entreprise doit suivre son portefeuille afin d’ajuster sa souscription. L’assurance est un produit atypique : le prix facturé est connu d’avance, mais pas le coût pour l’assureur. Un reporting détaillé est donc indispensable pour suivre d’un côté les primes, de l’autre les sinistres.
* Acteur de la cybersécurité, Stoïk collecte par ailleurs une grande quantité de données via ses scanners d’infrastructure et de vulnérabilités. Pour prévenir les incidents et réagir vite, ces données doivent être exploitées afin, par exemple, d’alerter les assurés concernés dès la publication d’une nouvelle faille critique.

**Principales missions**
------------------------

* Échanger avec les autres équipes, en particulier les équipes produit, opérations, finance et customer success, pour identifier les indicateurs qu’elles ont besoin de suivre. Cela suppose de comprendre nos processus produit, commerciaux et assurantiels.
* Écrire les transformations nécessaires au calcul de ces indicateurs à partir de nos données brutes. La fiabilité est primordiale. Ces calculs tournant régulièrement, les autres membres de l’équipe data vous aideront à traiter les enjeux d’optimisation.
* Choisir, pour chaque grandeur, les chiffres et les visualisations les plus adaptés. Une donnée n’est éclairante que si elle est présentée avec clarté, et un graphique compréhensible d’un seul coup d’œil fait toute la différence.
* Travailler sur les droits d’accès aux données, afin que chacun dispose des informations dont il a besoin tout en limitant l’exposition inutile aux données sensibles.
* Accompagner les utilisateurs avancés pour qu’ils construisent leurs propres tableaux de bord en s’appuyant sur le travail de l’équipe data.

**Profil recherché**
--------------------

Sur le plan technique, nous recherchons un ou une Data Analyst avec :

* Une solide maîtrise du SQL (indispensable). Une expérience de PostgreSQL en particulier est un plus, puisque c’est là que s’effectue l’essentiel de nos transformations de données.
* Une pratique de la construction de graphiques et de visualisations avec des outils comme Metabase, Tableau, Power BI ou équivalent. Au-delà de la maîtrise d’un logiciel précis, nous cherchons une bonne compréhension de la manière de présenter des chiffres.
* L’envie d’automatiser une partie de son propre travail à l’aide d’outils d’IA.
* Une expérience préalable des outils d’analytics produit web, comme PostHog, est un plus.

**Processus de recrutement**
----------------------------

* Un premier entretien de découverte
* Un test technique à réaliser chez vous
* Un second entretien pour échanger sur les résultats du test
* Un échange avec les fondateurs

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager III, Data Operations, Geo
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and the implementation of GenAI-driven moderation frameworks.
* Experience running technical programs and utilizing data analysis tools.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience working with external developers and APIs.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As a Technical Program Manager for the GDO Developer team, you will serve as a technical and strategic leader driving the Geo’s multi-ecosystem priorities (e.g. Destinations) and Makers Data Quality programs. You will act as a critical bridge between product requirements and geospatial data execution. You will lead high-complexity pillars involving AI, telemetry, and spatial analysis to establish "self-healing" pipelines from developer logs and scale spatial remediation initiatives. You’ll maintain strong alignment with executive leads, Product Managers, and Engineering counterparts to deliver on team goals.

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Collaborate with Geo Makers and Real World Model PMs to interpret product goal and convert overarching roadmaps into actionable, high-impact data initiatives.
* Partner with PM, Engineering and Data Science to implement coverage and quality improvement strategies and drive spatial remediation efforts globally.
* Steer technical experiments and analytics for data coverage and validation, utilizing agentic AI frameworks, Gemini-powered workflows, and machine learning models.
* Manage operational metrics, review evaluations, structure data acquisition business cases, and direct program pipelines efficiently.
* Prepare and deliver regular communications, presentations, and reports. Establish and maintain effective governance processes for Geo Data initiatives for developers.

jobs.title: Staff Security Program Manager, International Security
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

You'll join CoreWeave's Global Security & Resilience organization to build and drive the security program supporting our rapidly expanding international footprint — including offices we operate directly and locations where we support our data center teams. You'll work closely with executive protection, the GSOC, External Affairs, and cross-functional business leaders to protect our people and operations as CoreWeave scales globally.

The Staff Security Program Manager, International Security will own and drive CoreWeave's international security program, with responsibility for global travel security, international office and site protection, global security partnerships and outreach, and support for executive protection and event security as needed. You'll partner closely with CoreWeave's Senior Manager, Corporate Security, who leads the domestic program, to coordinate standards, incident response, and shared protective operations.

This individual contributor role combines enterprise program ownership with hands-on operational execution. You'll design and stand up a world-class travel security program — pre-travel risk assessments, traveler tracking and duty-of-care protocols, in-country support, and emergency response for employees traveling or working abroad. You'll also establish security standards for CoreWeave's growing international office footprint and the locations where CoreWeave supports its data center teams, in partnership with Facilities, Data Center Operations, and local leadership.

A significant part of this role is external-facing: building and sustaining global partnerships with law enforcement, intelligence services, diplomatic security, industry peers, and trusted local security providers in the countries where CoreWeave operates. You'll also provide tactical, hands-on support for executive protection and event security as needed — including advances, logistics coordination, and on-the-ground protective coverage — both domestically and internationally.

Success in this role requires strategic thinking, cultural fluency, and sound judgment operating in ambiguous, fast-moving international environments. You must be comfortable building programs from the ground up, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, working through a network of internal teams, contractors, and in-country partners, and delivering results with limited on-the-ground infrastructure. This role has no direct reports.

**About the role:**
-------------------

* Design, build, and own CoreWeave's global travel security program, including pre-travel risk assessments, country risk ratings, traveler tracking, duty-of-care protocols, and coordination of 24/7 emergency response and evacuation support for employees traveling or working abroad.
* Develop and maintain security standards, governance, and risk assessments for CoreWeave's international office footprint and the locations where CoreWeave supports its data center teams, balancing consistent global controls with local risk, culture, and regulatory requirements.
* Build and sustain global partnerships and outreach with foreign law enforcement, intelligence, diplomatic security, and industry security counterparts, as well as trusted in-country guard force, investigative, and protective service providers.
* Serve as CoreWeave's primary international security point of contact for new-market entry and international office openings, conducting site and country risk assessments and coordinating security coverage ahead of business expansion.
* Drive program execution across internal teams, regional security partners, and contracted providers, establishing clear requirements, coordinating deliverables, and evaluating provider performance.
* Personally plan and provide tactical, hands-on support for executive protection and high-profile event security as needed, including advances, route and venue assessments, logistics coordination, and on-site protective coverage domestically and abroad.
* Translate threat, political, and protective intelligence into practical guidance for travelers, international offices, and business leaders, including country and regional travel advisories.
* Coordinate with the GSOC, the domestic Corporate Security team, and internal response teams to ensure seamless monitoring, escalation, and incident management for international employees, offices, and events.
* Develop budget recommendations, manage approved international security program spend, and oversee the vendor and travel-security-provider portfolio and technology roadmap, including traveler tracking and mass-notification tools.
* Advise senior leaders and cross-functional partners in People, Legal, Real Estate, and Data Center Operations on international security risk and risk-informed business decisions.
* Establish metrics to evaluate program effectiveness, traveler safety outcomes, partner performance, and risk reduction across the international portfolio, and use findings to drive program improvements.

**Who You Are:**
----------------

* You have 10+ years of experience across international security, travel risk management, executive protection, or protective intelligence — ideally including government, law enforcement, military, or corporate security experience with an international or liaison component.
* You have direct, hands-on experience building or running a corporate travel security program, i

jobs.title: AI Program Manager, IT Dept
jobs.description:
This position will work one day per week onsite in San Francisco.

The AI Program Manager serves as an organization-wide expert and strategic advisor leading UCSF’s enterprise AI program across clinical care, research, education, and administrative operations. The incumbent partners with Enterprise AI product, technical, and leadership stakeholders to translate institutional priorities and complex business needs into adoption plans, enablement programs, stakeholder engagement strategies, feedback loops, and sustainable operating practices. The role evaluates organizational readiness, workflows, stakeholder needs, and performance data to identify opportunities that improve institutional effectiveness, workforce experience, quality, and mission outcomes.

The incumbent coordinates the adoption, enablement, communications, stakeholder engagement, value tracking, and operational readiness components of a high-impact portfolio of AI initiatives from intake through implementation, adoption, value realization, and transition to operations. The role supports prioritization and resource planning by preparing analysis, maintaining visibility into progress and risks, facilitating multidisciplinary coordination, and escalating complex or politically sensitive issues for leadership decision-making.

The AI Program Manager leads awareness and adoption of approved AI tools by communicating available capabilities, appropriate use cases, limitations, support resources, and product roadmaps. Working with senior leaders and clinical, research, academic, operational, technology, and risk stakeholders, the incumbent advances responsible AI adoption, informs vendor and product decisions, leads organizational change, and represents UCSF in relevant University and industry forums. The role works in close partnership with Enterprise AI product leadership, who retain accountability for product strategy, platform roadmap, prioritization recommendations, and product/vendor decision-making.

  

**Department Overview**

UCSF Enterprise Information and Analytics (EIA) advances the institution’s data and analytics capabilities in support of patient care, research, education, and administrative operations. EIA develops and maintains enterprise platforms and services that integrate data from across UCSF, promote consistent and trustworthy information, and support informed decision-making. Its portfolio includes enterprise data warehousing and data lakes, data integration, business intelligence, reporting and analytics, data governance, and data catalog services. EIA also establishes the policies, standards, and processes that enable institutional data to be accessed and used responsibly.

Enterprise AI builds on this foundation by delivering secure, scalable, and responsible artificial intelligence capabilities to the UCSF community. The program integrates AI strategy, governance, platforms, portfolio management, adoption, training, communications, and stakeholder engagement. jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
LifeLong Medical Care is looking for a **Data Analyst** to support the data analytic team including reporting development, data validation, and database maintenance, and provide assistance in further development of Tableau and reports in EPIC. The Data Analyst reports directly to the Health IT Applications and Support Manager. **This is a Full Time Hybrid/Remote role. Candidate must live in the Bay Area in California and** **be able to attend New Hire Orientation, employee trainings and meetings in person and then as necessary.**

**About us:**

As a Federally Qualified Health Center in Northern California with over 50 years of dedicated service to the community, LifeLong serves over 66,000 patients in the East Bay Area's socio-economically underserved regions. We provide medical, dental, behavioral health, and school-based services at more than 15 primary care sites across Oakland, Berkeley, and West Contra Costa County. From opening a residential respite program for homeless persons discharged from hospital to offering free testing to the community, we are innovative and responsive to our times' social and medical needs. We provide an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and with which our patients can identify. To this end, we seek candidates who reflect the diversity of the East Bay communities we serve.

**Benefits:**

We offer a competitive pay rate of **$33.11 to $36.94** per hour and excellent benefits: medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, dependent and domestic partner coverage, 403(b) retirement savings plan plus paid holidays, vacation and sick leave.

JOB DUTIES:

* Supports data analytic team with data reporting and provides assistance to all data reporting tool users in Lifelong Medical Care, including documentation of report requirements and report implementations.
* Provides analytic support to one or multiple departments and develops a variety of complex ad hoc, production and/or trend reports to support business decisions and operational processes for internal and external clients independently
* Assists in maintaining integrity of all databases including troubleshooting measures such as identification of error elements with notification to in-house source or outside vendor
* Assists in arranging project requirements in programming sequence by analyzing requirements, preparing a work flow chart and diagram using knowledge of computer capabilities, subject matter, programming language, and logic.
* Communicates with clients and key stakeholders to develop and create specification analytical applications.
* Develops and maintains internal reporting services platform using Structured Query Language (SQL) Server Reporting Services and Tableau.
* Assists data analytic team in database optimization and maintenance.

* Supports developments of Structured Query Language (SQL) scripts in data conversation for EPIC implementation.
* Protects operations by keeping information confidential and complies with HIPAA requirements
* Other duties as assigned.

* Commitment to the provision of primary care services for the underserved with demonstrated ability and sensitivity in working with a variety of people from low-income populations, with diverse educational, lifestyle, ethnic, and cultural origins.
* Be creative and mature with a “can do,” proactive attitude.
* Ability to effectively support and motivate colleagues, encourage and nurture development and growth, to build a strong and productive team.
* Strong organizational, administrative, multi-tasking, prioritization and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure in a positive, friendly manner and to be flexible and adaptive to change.
* Ability to take initiative, work independently and make sound judgments within established guidelines.
* Understand and apply oral and written instructions.
* Establish and maintain effective working relations with staff, clinical providers, managers and external agencies or organizations.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills and ability to effectively work with people from diverse backgrounds and be culturally sensitive.

* Work in a team-oriented environment with several professionals with different work styles and support needs.

Beveridge & Diamond, P.C., the foremost national corporate environmental law firm, is seeking an eDiscovery Project Manager to lead the planning and execution of complex electronic discovery matters across the litigation lifecycle.

Working under the general direction of the Director of Litigation Support & eDiscovery, the Project Manager serves as the primary operational lead for assigned matters and partners with attorneys, litigation support professionals, review teams, clients, and external service providers to deliver efficient, accurate, and defensible discovery solutions. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Onos Health**

Onos Health’s mission is simple but ambitious: ensure every healthcare dollar goes toward delivering the highest quality care. Today, nearly 30% of U.S. healthcare spending is wasted due to ineffective care and administrative burden caused by misalignment between providers and payers.

Onos is addressing this by building the AI platform that enables health plans to understand clinical care at scale. By transforming unstructured clinical documentation into actionable insights, we help payers make faster, more informed decisions, identify opportunities to improve quality and reduce waste, and ensure more healthcare dollars are directed toward delivering better outcomes.

Come join a category-defining company and transform how healthcare is managed in the U.S.

**Why Onos?**

Meaningful impact: Help solve one of healthcare’s biggest challenges by improving quality while reducing waste.

Ownership: Take on significant responsibility from day one and shape a rapidly growing company.

Direct collaboration: Work alongside experienced founders with deep expertise in healthcare, AI, and product development.

High-performing team: Join a transparent, collaborative, and execution-focused culture.

Build something new: Help define the next generation of AI-powered healthcare analytics.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to turn health plan data into the reporting, analyses, and insights our customers rely on.

You’ll work hands-on with claims, authorization, eligibility, and clinical review data from our health plan customers. You’ll build and maintain the analyses and dashboards that show customers what’s happening in their populations: utilization trends, provider variation, cost, and the impact of programs running on the Onos platform.

This role works closely with our data science, product, and customer teams. This role is tightly focused on core analytics – tackling complex analytical questions independently. You’ll own analyses end to end, from digging into data to presenting results to customer stakeholders, and you’ll help make repeatable analyses into standard reporting in the product.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Customer Analytics & Reporting**

* Build and maintain customer-facing reports and dashboards covering utilization, cost, provider performance, and program outcomes.
* Run analyses that answer specific customer questions, such as where spend is concentrated, which providers are outliers, and how a program is affecting utilization.
* Support ROI and impact analyses by preparing data, running calculations, and checking results against agreed methodologies.
* Prepare findings for customer meetings and present results to analytics and operational teams at health plans.

**Data Onboarding & Quality**

* Explore and analyze structured, analysis-ready customer data feeds (including claims, authorizations, eligibility, and clinical documentation) to extract key insights.
* Investigate data quality issues, anomalies, and inconsistencies, collaborating closely with Engineering and customer teams to ensure accurate reporting.
* Partner with Data Engineering to define business logic and data requirements needed for downstream analytical workflows.
* Build checks that catch data issues before they reach customer reporting.

**Product Support**

* Turn recurring customer analyses into standard metrics and reports that can be built into the platform.
* Help define metric logic and business rules so numbers are consistent across customers and reports.
* Give Product, Engineering, and Data Science feedback on what customers ask for and where current reporting falls short.

**Collaborate Across the Company**

* Work with Data Science, Product, Engineering, Clinical Operations, and Customer Success on customer engagements and internal projects.
* Be a go-to resource on how our customers’ data is structured and what it can and can’t support.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4+ years of experience in healthcare analytics or a related analytical role.
* Hands-on experience with healthcare claims data; experience with authorization, eligibility, or clinical data is a plus.
* Strong SQL skills, working proficiency in Python for data analysis, and proven ability to independently answer complex, ambiguous analytical questions.
* Experience building dashboards and reports in a BI or notebook tool.
* Solid understanding of descriptive statistics and common healthcare metrics (e.g., PMPM, utilization per 1,000, cost per member).
* Careful about data quality, with a habit of checking results before sharing them.
* Ability to explain analytical findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Proven experience working directly with customers or external stakeholders is required.
* Comfortable working in ambiguity and building processes from the ground up.
* Healthcare payer, provider, or health technology experience strongly preferred. Behavioral health experience is a plus.
* Exceptional references from colleagues and former managers.

**Why This Role Is Unique**

At Onos, Analysts aren’t a back-office reporting function.

You’ll work directly with health plan customers, see how your analyses inform their decisions, and help shape the reporting built into the Onos platform.

If you like digging into messy healthcare data, getting the numbers right, and seeing your work used by customers, we’d love to talk.

**Benefits & Perks**

* 3x per week in office (Mon/Tues/Thurs) in San Francisco, Financial District
* Unlimited vacation policy
* Paid parental leave
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* 401(k)
* Significant equity as an early employee
* Direct mentorship from experienced founders
* Ground-floor opportunity to help build both the product and company
* Regular team events and off-sites
* Company-provided equipment and home office setup
* In-office lunches and snacks provided

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at On

With direction and support from the Epic Program Manager, the Epic Project Manager will manage Epic-related projects and initiatives supporting the ongoing success and maintenance of the electronic health record system and integrated third-party vendors. Projects include Epic application and third-party vendor implementations, optimizations as well as build and training efforts supporting new Central Health system service lines and locations.

The Epic Project Manager will work closely with the Epic Application Analyst Team, Epic Training Team, Business Intelligence Teams and system-wide Project Management Offices, as well as operational and clinical leaders, to implement, monitor, and improve Epic-related initiatives.

As a member of the Epic Project Management Office, core expectations will include adhering to and optimizing standardized approaches to project management, including but not limited to, developing and maintaining project schedules, controlling scope, monitoring budget, identifying and mitigating risks, and serving as a strategic thinking partner within the project team.

The Epic Project Manager will also coordinate ongoing Epic workgroups, which are responsible for Epic change requests and optimizations, new feature review and prioritization during upgrades, and issue mitigation. Epic Project Managers may be involved in additional project/programmatic efforts as needed. These responsibilities should be completed in a manner consistent with Central Health's mission.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Functions**

* Manage and coordinate projects to include establishing and implementing work plans, leading activities of various workgroups, and managing day-to-day operational aspects of a project.
* Work with project team members or subject matter experts to define project scope, goals, resource requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
* Continually monitor and report project progress to stakeholders, identifying risk points, and proposing solutions or escalating to leadership as needed.
* Create, maintain, and update key project documentation in a timely manner, including risk registers, change logs, and meeting notes.
* Maintain strong organization across projects and escalate sudden project changes including changes to timeline, resources, or scope, in a timely manner.
* Develop and maintain a working knowledge of existing operations and workstreams to maximize coordination and efficiency across Epic-related projects.
* Participate in strategic or operational planning exercises for the Central Health system as needed.
* Collaborate with multiple functional areas across the organization to gather operational requirements, improve processes, and influence operations as they pertain to assigned projects.
* Engage with operations to prepare for adoption of Epic optimizations and enhancements.
* Manage the day-to-day work of the Epic workgroups including reviewing change requests, vetting of new feature releases, and guiding evaluation of operational considerations and readiness.
* Serve as resource person/liaison between Epic team members, system-wide PMOs, and clinical/operational team members.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

**MINIMUM EDUCATION:** Bachelors Degree required

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:**

* 3 years of Epic and/or IT project management with a bachelor’s degree **OR**
* 1 of Epic and/or IT project management with a master’s degree

**POSITION TITLE:** Senior HR Business Analyst SharePoint

**LOCATION:** Remote

**CLEARANCE:** Must be able to obtain a High-Risk Public Trust

  

**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

  

At APV, we’re more than a technology company — we’re a mission-driven powerhouse transforming organizations through advanced technology and human ingenuity. Our expertise spans AI/ML, data architecture, low-code/no-code development, Agile DevSecOps, and cloud services, delivering scalable and meaningful solutions.

In our Emerging Technology Lab, innovation drives progress. Our teams create intelligent chatbots, AI-powered assistants, robotic process automation (RPA), essay graders, and data analytics platforms. If you’re passionate about solving complex challenges and shaping the future, APV is the place for you. Since 2007, we’ve partnered with federal and state agencies to deliver IT, training, and consulting solutions that achieve mission-critical outcomes. Built on accountability, integrity, and quality, we go beyond expectations. With 70+ prime contracts and a proven record of client success, APV continues to grow — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

  

**At APV, we Always Provide Value**

  

**POSITION SUMMARY**

  

APV is seeking a Senior HR Business Analyst with hands-on SharePoint and Microsoft Power Platform experience to support DHS human resources operations. The analyst will work with federal HR leaders and program teams to define requirements, improve processes, and deliver practical tools for managing work, information, and reporting. The role combines HR business analysis, stakeholder coordination, and solution configuration to improve service delivery and support modernization.

  

**DUTIES**

  

* Meet with HR stakeholders to define business needs, identify operational gaps, and document requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and priorities.
* Analyze current HR workflows and recommend practical improvements for intake, assignments, approvals, tracking, reporting, and knowledge transfer.
* Design and maintain SharePoint Online sites, lists, document libraries, metadata, views, navigation, and permissions within authorized access and governance controls.
* Build and maintain Power Automate workflows and Power Apps solutions for HR intake, routing, notifications, status tracking, and approvals in approved environments.
* Develop Power BI dashboards and Excel reports to show workload, aging actions, milestones, service trends, and other agreed performance measures.
* Support employee and labor relations, awards, and other assigned HR programs by translating process needs into organized information and usable tools.
* Create process maps, standard operating procedures, requirements documents, job aids, training materials, and clear recommendations for client review.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing, track defects, validate data and outputs, and support approved solution deployment, adoption, and issue resolution.
* Organize content inventories, data mapping, validation, and migration activities; coordinate dependencies with HR system owners and technical teams.
* Protect sensitive HR information through approved permissions, data handling, retention, and sharing practices; coordinate with privacy, security, and records officials.
* Lead prepared working sessions, document decisions and action items, meet deadlines, remain responsive during agreed work hours, and escalate risks promptly.

  

**EDUCATION**

  

Bachelor's degree in human resources, business administration, information systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience where permitted by the contract.

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Five or more years of relevant business analysis, HR process improvement, or business systems experience, including three or more years working with SharePoint Online.
* Demonstrated experience analyzing HR or human capital processes and translating stakeholder needs into clear requirements and workable solutions.
* Hands-on experience configuring SharePoint sites, lists, libraries, metadata, permissions, and document management structures.
* Experience developing Power Automate workflows, configuring Power Apps, and creating Power BI or advanced Excel reports.
* Ability to produce process maps, requirements documents, standard operating procedures, test scenarios, and user training materials.
* Strong client communication, meeting facilitation, analytical judgment, and follow-through; ability to manage multiple assignments independently and recommend next steps.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a High-Risk Public Trust or equivalent federal client access. This role supports sensitive federal programs and involves elevated access to systems and data.
* Position requires the current ability to obtain and maintain required access without interruption in alignment with long-term program needs.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Experience supporting DHS, OCHCO, federal HR shared services, or another federal human capital program.
* Experience supporting employee and labor relations, awards, performance management, onboarding, or related HR service processes.
* Experience with Microsoft 365 governance, accessible solution design, sensitive personnel information, and records management practices.
* Familiarity with HR modernization, Core HCM transitions, data migration, basic SQL, or approved data integrations.
* Relevant Microsoft SharePoint, Power Platform, business analysis, or project management certification.

  

**ABOUT APV**

  

APV is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or marital status.

Overview:

LMI is seeking a Data Analyst to support Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) modernization initiatives. These full-time positions provide hands-on analytical capacity across AI-enabled use cases, operational improvement, workflow modernization, performance measurement, reporting, data-quality assessment, and decision support.

The Data Analysts will use SQL and Python as core day-to-day tools to acquire, prepare, validate, analyze, and automate data workflows. **Description**

### **Illuminate Emerging Adversary Campaigns Across the Pacific Cyberspace Frontier**

Leidos is seeking an experienced, analytical **Cyber Threat Analyst** to join our Defensive Cyber Operations (DCO) team supporting Defense Information Systems Agency Pacific (DISA PAC) at Ford Island, Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam, HI. Operating under the Global Services Management – Operations II (GSM-O II) Task Order 22 (TN22) Boundary Cyber Defense and Cybersecurity Services Provider (CSSP) contract, our mission is to defend the Department of Defense Information Network (DODIN/DISN), U.S. Pacific Command (USPACOM), and critical mission partner enclaves against sophisticated advanced persistent threats and nation-state cyber actors.

In this high-impact intelligence and analysis role, you will synthesize multi-source intelligence, telemetry, and forensic data into actionable threat intelligence. You will analyze adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), formulate threat indicators, track advanced adversary campaigns, and direct threat-informed defense operations across perimeter boundaries, multi-cloud platforms, and classified networks—spanning Unclassified (NIPRNet) and Secret (SIPRNet) up to Top Secret/SCI.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **1. Boundary Threat Analysis & Adversary Characterization**

* **Warning Intelligence & Attack Sensing:** Analyze boundary sensor feeds, Netflow, and IDS/IPS logs in conjunction with intelligence agencies, peer CSSPs, and commercial intelligence providers to deliver Warning Intelligence and Attack Sensing and Warning activities compliant with DoDI 8530.01.
* **Adversary Campaign Tracking:** Apply the **MITRE ATT&CK®** and Cyber Kill Chain frameworks to characterize adversary behavior, track campaign evolution, identify "Living off the Land" (LotL) tradecraft, and assess the operational impact of targeted threats traversing enterprise Internet Access Points and Boundary Cloud Access Points.
* **Actionable Battlefield Intelligence:** Author, refine, and disseminate high-impact, actionable battlefield cyber threat analysis products, Threat Warnings, and Tippers that empower tactical defenders and boundary engineers to preempt emerging cyber assaults.
* **Automated Telemetry & Breach Assessment:** Evaluate bypasses and telemetry from automated blocking platforms to uncover adversary evasion techniques, evaluate malicious patterns, and generate targeted analytic hypotheses.
* **Operational Reporting & DJOC Synchronization:** Coordinate closely with the DISA Joint Operations Center (DJOC), USPACOM J6, DoD Cyber Defense Command (DCDC), USCYBERCOM, and the National Security Agency (NSA) to synchronize threat analyses and maintain standardized incident reporting in the DoD-mandated reporting structure (currently Rally).

### **2. Enterprise CSSP Intelligence & Proactive Threat Hunting**

* **Deliberate Defense (DD) & Discovery Counter Infiltration (DCI):** Formulate threat hypotheses based on all-source intelligence, reconstruct multi-stage adversary attack paths, and conduct structured threat-hunting across enterprise endpoints and cloud enclaves to validate malicious presence or confirm its absence.
* **Multi-Cloud & Zero Trust Threat Analysis:** Track advanced persistent threats operating against enterprise cloud ecosystems (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, Google Cloud Platform, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) secured under the Joint Warfighter Cloud Capability, Thunderdome Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and Microsoft Defender suite (EndGuard).
* **Analytic Capability & Use Case Development:** Translate threat intelligence and adversary TTPs into specific detection use cases, rule logic, and detection requirements for ingestion into enterprise SIEMs (Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Elastic, and JCRS-D).
* **Aggregated Threat Trend Reporting:** Aggregate threat indicators, malware behaviors, and adversary profiles from commercial threat feeds (e.g., CrowdStrike, VirusTotal) and internal investigations; provide inputs for the quarterly Aggregated Cyber Awareness Report detailing strategic threat forecasts and vulnerability exposures.
* **Vulnerability & Exposure Intelligence:** Continuously assess Information Assurance Vulnerability Management notices (IAVAs and IAVBs) against active adversary exploitation trends, providing technical threat context and impact assessments to mission partner enclaves.

### **3. Location-Specific & Above-Secret Intelligence: PACOM & TS/SCI**

* **PACOM Mission Network (PMN) and Joint Operational Edge – Coalition Environment (JOE-CE) Threat Assessment:** Provide dedicated cyber threat intelligence and behavioral profiling tailored to the PMN and JOE-CE operational networks.
* **User & Entity Behavioral Profiling:** Analyze Identity, Credential, and Access Management telemetry and the PMN Master User Record to identify anomalous user behavior, insider threats, and sophisticated lateral movement.
* **SCIF-Based Intelligence Operations:** Conduct all-source cyber analysis within Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIF) at Ford Island, examining multi-discipline intelligence across JWICS, YLAN, and special-access enclaves up to Top Secret / SCI.
* **Cross-Echelon Coordination:** Brief Senior Executive and military leadership across USPACOM, DISA PAC, and operational mission partners on adversary threat capabilities, active campaigns, and strategic risk postures.

**What You’ll Need for Success**
--------------------------------

**Project Management and Execution**

* Develop, implement, and maintain project plans for assigned eDiscovery matters, including scope, schedules, milestones, resource requirements, dependencies, quality requirements, and deliverables.
* Manage daily project activities across the discovery lifecycle, from initial planning, preservation, and data collection through processing, review, production, and project closeout.
* Coordinate assignments and workflow sequencing among litigation support analysts, attorneys, review teams, clients, and external vendors.
* Monitor project progress, identify potential delays or resource constraints, and implement corrective actions within established authority.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects while ensuring compliance with established deadlines, requirements, and quality standards.

**eDiscovery Workflow and Technical Coordination**

* Design and coordinate discovery workflows based on matter requirements, data characteristics, and case-team objectives.
* Coordinate preservation and collection activities under attorney direction, including custodians, data sources, collection status, secure transfers, chain-of-custody documentation, and identification of gaps requiring follow-up.
* Translate attorney-approved discovery requirements into processing and production specifications and work with technical personnel and vendors to confirm data completeness, metadata accuracy, document relationships, and resolution of processing exceptions.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate use of eDiscovery tools, search methods, early case assessment, analytics, technology-assisted review, and related technologies.
* Support implementation and validation of AI-enabled discovery workflows, including data preparation, issue-prompt refinement, workflow configuration, pilot testing, sampling, quality control, and documentation, in coordination with the Director and case team.
* Coordinate technical troubleshooting and resolution of workflow issues.

**Budget and Resource Management**

* Prepare project cost estimates and budgets based on anticipated scope, data volumes, staffing, hosting, and vendor requirements.
* Monitor project expenditures, resource utilization, and progress against approved budgets.
* Identify and communicate potential budget variances, cost implications, and opportunities for improved efficiency.
* Coordinate vendor resources, services, and deliverables to support project objectives.
* Maintain accurate project records to support billing, cost recovery, and financial reporting.

**Quality Assurance and Risk Management**

* Establish and oversee project-level quality assurance procedures for data processing, review workflows, and productions.
* Perform or coordinate production quality control, including checks of production scope, redactions, privilege exclusions, metadata, load files, and output specifications; resolve discrepancies and obtain required approvals before release.
* Monitor technical deliverables for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with established requirements.
* Identify operational, technical, scheduling, and resource risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures within established authority.
* Escalate significant issues affecting discovery obligations, project scope, costs, or case strategy to appropriate stakeholders and maintain documentation supporting defensible discovery practices.

**Attorney and Stakeholder Coordination**

* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned eDiscovery projects and lead appropriate kickoff and status meetings.
* Communicate project status, milestones, risks, budget considerations, and technical requirements to attorneys and case teams.
* Coordinate with Staff Attorneys and case teams regarding document review workflows, batching plans, reviewer guidance, review protocols, privilege-review quality checks, privilege-log preparation, and progress reporting under attorney direction.
* Translate technical information into practical recommendations that support informed case-team decisions.
* Facilitate communication and accountability among internal personnel, external vendors, and other project stakeholders.
